name: Streamarr
description: Stream Usenet content on demand through the Streamarr Core Server. Thin adapter — no download-to-disk.
overview: Surfaces the Streamarr Core Server's Usenet search results inside Jellyfin and makes them playable through Jellyfin's transcoding pipeline.
changelog: My List: a new tab that keeps every started series (no time limit), movies, series and seasons you add, with progress and a want-to-watch/watching/caught-up/watched status; the server watches caught-up series and flags a new episode only once a usable release exists, with a badge on the tab. Connection & diagnostics: a speed test between the app and the server with a quality verdict, and a server diagnostics page (indexers, Usenet providers, TMDB, database, storage) in the app and the admin web. Viewers see a service status banner and a clear failure card during server-side outages; the admin can get Pushover on outage and recovery. Version picker: 4K/HDR is recommended when the device plays it directly, the series affinity prefers the release you watched, and the same release from two indexers is listed once. The ranking profile can be chosen: a server default per movies/series in the admin web, and per viewer in the app. The viewer web app (/watch) uses desktop sizes, follows browser zoom and no longer fails the first playback after a page load. Performance mode keeps focus, menu and banner animations and only calms Home. The Jellyfin plugin itself is unchanged.
